selection_protocol.manual_review: Ten uniformly spaced frames over each full candidate video were globally reviewed before assigning the video to a target distribution.

split_names.evolution: Used for distribution profiling and evolution under the annotation-access protocol.
split_names.held_out: Used only for external reporting; annotations and outcomes are inaccessible to the evolution method.

distributions.name: Interview
distributions.evidence_requirements: spoken content, speaker identity, and local visual interactions

distributions.name: Product Presentation
distributions.evidence_requirements: product attributes, displayed text, orientation, and relative positions

distributions.name: Software Tutorial
distributions.evidence_requirements: interface text, operation order, and state changes

distributions.name: Dramatic Narrative
distributions.evidence_requirements: characters, events, and relations across cuts

distributions.name: Stage Performance
distributions.evidence_requirements: event phases, ordinal relations, and brief actions

distributions.name: Gameplay
distributions.evidence_requirements: dynamic scene state, player/object actions, and interface evidence

distributions.name: Sports Broadcast
distributions.evidence_requirements: subject tracking across views, actions, scores, and localized events

distributions.name: Course Lecture
distributions.evidence_requirements: lecture content, on-screen text, concepts, and page--speech timing
